en: Color-tinted vintage postcard showing a tall circular stone tower with an eagle statue on its spire, smaller turret beside it, and a round colonnaded gallery above a rough stone base surrounded by greenery. German printed caption reads "Millenium‑Denkmal." Another printed caption at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Semlin." There is cursive handwriting in the margins and bottom area in a South Slavic (Serbian/Cyrillic) script.
